title: fix(console): the shared-record page shows a lookup as "Linked record", never its stored id
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XLP7yPUeEpHsHyGhzfziP4q)_

Fixes #31326

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：分享链接页 `/s/TOKEN` 上，有值的查找字段与主从字段不再显示被关联记录的存储 ID，改为显示本地化的中性占位「已关联记录」/ "Linked record"；空值仍显示为空。是否为查找字段，按 resolve 应答 `fields` 投影里已下发的 `type` 判断，不看值的形状。
- 为什么改：匿名访客看到一串内部 ID，读起来像页面坏了（#27200 字母 C 裁决）。显示目标记录名称是选项 B，仍挂在 #27200，本 PR 不碰。
- 风险与回滚：只改 console 一页的展示层，外加 `@object-ui/i18n` 每个语言包一个新键 `sharedRecord.linkedRecord`；不改 resolve 接口、不改服务端、不多发请求、不读目标记录。旧服务端不返回 `fields` 时没有类型可读，页面与之前一样。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`ui/apps/console/src/pages/SharedRecordFields.tsx`（`RECORD_REFERENCE_TYPES` 与行渲染的分支）、`SharedRecordPage-27121.test.tsx` 末尾新增的 `objectstack#31326` describe。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/pages/SharedRecordPage-27121.test.tsx`，预期 13 个用例全绿，其中查找、主从、多值查找三例断言整个 DOM 里找不到存储 ID。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`SharedRecordFields.tsx`** (`@object-ui/console`): a row whose projected field `type` is `lookup` or `master_detail` (`RECORD_REFERENCE_TYPES`) no longer renders its value. A filled one (an id, or a non-empty array of ids for a multiple lookup) renders `t('sharedRecord.linkedRecord')` in the muted foreground; an empty one (null, undefined, empty string, empty array) renders the page's existing empty face. The decision reads the `type` the resolve answer's `fields` projection already serves, never the value's shape. The branch sits before the no-fetch cell renderers, so nothing for these rows reads the target record, the data source or the meta door. The module header now states this rule in place of "the id is what shows".
- **`@object-ui/i18n`**: every built-in pack gains `sharedRecord.linkedRecord` (en "Linked record", zh-Hans 「已关联记录」, the other nine translated). `zh-Hant.ts` was produced by `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n gen:zh-hant`, and a rerun reproduces the committed file byte for byte.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/31326-shared-lookup-placeholder.md`: `@object-ui/console` and `@object-ui/i18n` patch, with both declaration lines.
- Not changed: `GET /api/v1/share-links/TOKEN/resolve`, `packages/types/src/share-link-resolve-answer.ts`, and any server code.

## Tests

- `SharedRecordPage-27121.test.tsx`, the page's existing harness, rendered through the real route with the resolve answer stubbed the way both producers send it.
  - New top-level describe for objectstack#31326 (6 cases), fed an `opportunity` answer: a filled lookup (and the registry-injected `created_by` lookup) shows the placeholder and its id is absent from `document.body.innerHTML`, and only the resolve request is made; a filled master-detail likewise; a multiple lookup shows one placeholder and none of its ids; an empty lookup renders the empty face; under a zh `I18nProvider` the placeholder is the zh-Hans pack's value (guarded as a real zh row); CONTROL: text fields render their values as before.
  - Two #27121 cases that pinned the old behaviour now pin the new one: the lookup row reads "Linked record", and under a host data source the id and the target's name are absent from the DOM while `find`, `findOne` and `getObjectSchema` are never called.
  - Unchanged and green: an answer without `fields` (an older server) still shows the id, because no type is served to read.
- Ablation on head `d33a03b2` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: the reference-type branch was replaced with a constant false, so the raw value renders again (anchor 1 to 0, blob `7bf595db` to `52d8493a`). Result: 6 of 13 red (the six cases that assert the placeholder or the id's absence); the empty-lookup preservation case and the control stay green. Restored: blob equal to HEAD (`7bf595db`) and `git diff HEAD` empty. The console tests read `SharedRecordFields.tsx` from source by relative import, so no build sat between the mutation and the run.

## Acceptance notes

- **Which types.** The card names lookup and master-detail, and this PR covers exactly those two `type` values. A `user` field is stored the same way (a `sys_user` id) and, by reading the code path, still renders its id on this page; a `tree` field may too. Not measured on a live page; noted for the seat, not filed.
- **An older server.** An answer without `fields` carries no `type`, so a lookup there still shows its id, as before #27121. Guessing from the value's shape was ruled out by the order.
- **Option B** (the target's name) stays on #27200; nothing here reads or serves it.
- **Declaration lines.** The claim opened at `Clause-②: no`; adding an `@object-ui/i18n` key is published surface, so this PR and its changeset declare `yes (widening)`. `Metadata-protocol: none`: nothing a metadata author writes changes.
